versions.content: When Mirror_StopSourceNetwork is called to stop a CAN source bus, the Bus Mirroring module shall call CanIf_EnableBusMirroring with MirroringActive set to FALSE to stop reporting of received and transmitted CAN frames from the corresponding CAN controller.
